vb_textbox.text: Hello,My advice to you is that it seems like this game is completely random. I tried to follow patterns of different shaped hats and checked if I scored more points selecting one over the other but found no great difference between flat or tall hats. I also tested the colours and seemed no great difference there either. What I kept doing is, if I selected right and got good point I would keep selecting right until I got 2 or 3 consequetive low point scores then I would switch to the left and repeat this process. I found it to be effective to me but by all means trust your gut, good luck and free Palestine.
